title: Ghost Murmur quantum sensor detects a soldier's heartbeat

tellings.quote: And he was I think he needed to be rescued and they detected his heartbeat via this quantum sensing modality.

plain: A sensor called Ghost Murmur, which uses quantum physics to pick up very faint signals, is said to have found a soldier who needed rescuing somewhere in the Middle East, possibly Iran or Afghanistan, by detecting his heartbeat. Michels tells this himself, linking it to Lockheed Martin, a large American weapons maker, and without naming his source. If true, it would mean such sensing has moved from theory into real rescue work.
